'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey. I’ll tell you as a friend, that in trade what matters is how you present yourself, not being a dork or a nerd. Then, not only girls, but also customers will love you. This is my secret, feel free to use. I have a little business proposition to Elvira, the chief therapist at the hospital. But I can only trust you with this if you pump up your charisma, because right now she won’t even look at you, no offense. Gonna make a real man out of you.}}

==Objectives==
* Reach the required [[Charisma|Charisma skill]] level of 10

==Rewards==
* +15,600 [[EXP]]
*[[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 60,000 Roubles
** 63,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 69,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Ars Arma A18 Skanda plate carrier (MultiCam)]]
* Unlocks barter for [[FORT Redut-M body armor]] at [[Ragman]] LL4
{{quote|Wow wow, easy there, I'm on your side, man! Sorry, I'm just fucking around. I see you have mastered your charisma, that's good. Let's talk about business then.}}
